thread:
maria_cs: Heads up — ThunderBay returned the vendor questionnaire. Main asks: BYOK support for embeddings, retention windows, and a SOC2 excerpt showing cloud processing regions. They said renewal decision depends on BYOK availability.

alex_se: Ack. Do we have a short answer we can send while we gather evidence?

lee_security: Short answer: Hosted API does not support customer-managed keys (BYOK) today. Dedicated and Private do. We can offer a data residency + KMS plan on Dedicated.

maria_cs: Can you paste the exact wording I should send? customer is picky about legal language.

lee_security: Use this snippet: ```We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) with Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private deployments. For Hosted API customers we provide provider-managed encryption keys and documented access controls. If BYOK is a hard requirement for renewal, we can scope a Dedicated engagement and provide an implementation timeline.```

samir_success_engineer: Also note embeddings retention: ThunderBay asked for 30-day auto-delete and proof. We currently surface embeddings retention config only on Dedicated/Private or via contract. For Hosted we retain ephemeral KV for 7 days default.

maria_cs: Oof — they expected Hosted parity. That increases renewal risk. Julia/legal, can we offer a contractual retention SLA for Hosted while we discuss Dedicated?

julia_legal: We can propose a Data Processing Addendum amendment that commits to a shorter retention window for specific customer data categories, but BYOK is a product capability change — needs engineering + procurement terms. I can draft an amendment if product confirms feasible fallback.

onboard-bot: New ticket created: CS-5849 — "ThunderBay DPA follow-up / BYOK & retention" (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5849)

alex_se: I'll link the SOC2 excerpt they asked for. Where's the latest artifact that lists processing regions?

lee_security: Uploaded the SOC2 section to the secure share: https://redwood.internal/security/soc2-redacted/2025-exhibit-regions.pdf — note it's redacted for customer-facing use. If they need full SOC2, we require an NDA/bridge.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll send the SOC2 redacted doc and Lee's BYOK snippet. Also propose a short call: "technical BYOK scoping call" this week. Can someone join?

samir_success_engineer: I can join Thursday 10am PT. I'll prepare a short slide: architecture options + timeline.

lee_security: I'll be there for the KMS details.

julia_legal: I'll join for contract points if we get to amendments.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) alex — send redacted SOC2 + Lee wording to the customer now (include CS-5849). 2) samir + lee + julia — join Thursday 10am PT call. 3) alex — add note to the renewal risk tracker (link in ticket).

alex_se: Sending now. Message to customer: "Thanks — attaching SOC2 excerpt and our BYOK/retention guidance. We can schedule a short technical call to scope Dedicated if BYOK is required for renewal. Please confirm availability for Thu 10am PT." :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll update the account health score to 'watch' and flag renewal as medium-high risk until call outcome.

lee_security: Quick internal note: Engineering roadmap has BYOK for Dedicated in Q3 roadmap, not as Hosted feature. If customer pushes, potential acceleration cost to discuss with PL.

maria_cs: Noted. We'll surface that in call. Closing loop here — will paste customer reply in this thread.

onboard-bot: Reminder — CS-5849 scheduled meeting Thu 10:00 PT (2 attendees)
